ios.desc:
One line. Every square. No lifting a paw.

Meowzip is a daily logic puzzle with a cat problem. Start at 1, end at the last number, and trace a single unbroken path that fills every square on the grid. Simple rules, genuinely tricky puzzles, and one very smug cat watching you get it wrong.

HOW IT WORKS

Numbers sit scattered across a grid. Draw one continuous line that visits them in order — 1, 2, 3 and on — while covering every empty square along the way.
No square left behind. No crossing your own path. Miss one and the whole thing unravels.

Ten seconds to learn. Considerably longer to stop thinking about.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY

A fresh puzzle lands every morning. Solve it, keep your streak alive, come back tomorrow. Miss a day and the cat will remember.

WHY YOU'LL STAY

• Pure logic — no guessing, no luck, no dead ends
• Clean, calm design that stays out of your way
• Play at your own pace
• Six languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French and Arabic

PERFECT FOR

Five minutes in a queue. Your morning coffee. The commute home. Any moment you'd rather use your brain than scroll past something you won't remember.

If you already love Sudoku, nonograms, Minesweeper or a good daily brain teaser, you'll be at home immediately. If you've never solved one of these before, the early puzzles will teach you everything you need — no tutorial wall, no fuss.

Draw the purr-fect path. Your cat is waiting.
